method: Round 7, beyond the round-6 window. (1) Paging: pkg.go.dev search shows at most 100 results per query; for 'yaml', 'yaml parser', 'yaml decoder', 'yaml 1.2' and 'yaml unmarshal', page=2 returns the same first-100 window again (0-1 different hits, from relevance-order jitter) and limit=200 returns no results (paging_check), so results beyond the first 100 are not reachable through the search UI. (2) Twelve more package searches ('yml', 'yaml tokenizer', 'yaml node', 'yaml document', 'yaml stream', 'yaml event', 'libyaml go', 'libyaml', 'yaml scanner', 'yaml reader', 'yaml loader', 'yaml library') and eight symbol searches (m=symbol: 'yaml Unmarshal', 'yaml Parse', 'yaml Decoder', 'yaml Node', 'yaml Load', 'yaml Event', 'yaml Token', 'yaml Scanner'), first 100 hits each, captured 2026-11-18 between 02:31 and 02:33 UTC. Metric: pkg.go.dev Imported by from the search snippet (round-1 source); a symbol hit is recorded under its package. Hits already in any data/go/yaml file are not repeated. Every new hit with a positive value is decided: fork overlap with the round-3 method (module zips from proxy.golang.org, @latest unless noted; distinct stripped non-comment lines of the package's non-test .go files) against yaml.v2 v2.4.0, yaml.v3 v3.0.1, goccy/go-yaml v1.19.2 and its v1.11.3/v1.12.0/v1.13.0/v1.15.0 releases, go.yaml.in/yaml/v4 v4.0.0, go-rotini/yaml v1.2.6, candiedyaml, ghodss/yaml, go-gypsy and beego/goyaml2; the YAML/JSON imports of the remaining hits from their pkg.go.dev imports tab; proxy.golang.org version lists for release pins; module zips read for the named candidates. tabnas/yaml/go passed both controls on a host probe and in Docker and is promoted (its project carries the Docker and AFL++ receipts).
